title: Trump Calls A.I. Fears a Hoax. Inside the White House, the Debate Is More Complex.
summary: The president seems driven chiefly by the sense that A.I. is the way to economic growth, and nothing can be allowed to stand in its way.

title: How Trump Became an A.I. Evangelist
summary: President Trump had little interest in artificial intelligence until a fateful meeting in Las Vegas two years ago. Now, Mr. Trump sees A.I. as the defining technology of our age. Our White House correspondent Jonathan Swan tracks Trump’s journey to A.I. evangelist.

title: Anthropic Pursues IPO Despite Its A.I. Safety Warnings
summary: The company is expected to reach $100 billion in annualized revenue this year, even as chief executive Dario Amodei calls for slowing down development of some advanced A.I. models.

title: Gemini AI Hacked Three Companies in a Testing Breakout, Google Says
summary: A third-party test company inadvertently gave internet access to Google’s Gemini and other artificial intelligence models during cybersecurity testing.

title: F.A.A. to Roll Out New A.I. Tool for Washington Airports
summary: The tool, called SMART, will crunch scheduling and weather data to predict and avoid delays. It will be deployed in the Washington region’s three major airports next week.

title: Russia Holds Stage-Managed Elections
summary: Also, a new kind of cat was found. Here’s the latest at the end of Friday.

title: Kennedy Center Supporters Rally Amid Fears of Trump’s Demolition
summary: Photos of President Trump reviewing a poster board with the title “Kennedy Center DEMOLISHED” spurred the largest gathering yet in support of the performing arts institution.

title: U.S. and Denmark Reach Security Deal on Greenland, Trump Says
summary: The full contours of the deal were unclear, but Denmark and Greenland both indicated they expected an agreement to be signed soon.

title: At Gettysburg, a Reporter Captured a Nation’s Loss, and His Own
summary: Samuel Wilkeson Jr. filed a report for The Times from the battlefield. Then he went looking for a Union officer, his son.

title: New Species of Cat Discovered for First Time in a Century
summary: The species, called a tilcayo, is smaller than a house cat and lives in the cloud forests of the Andes Mountains in Bolivia.

title: Russia Aims to Inject Chaos Into Elections, U.S. Intelligence Finds
summary: The Kremlin is once again seeking to undermine confidence in American democracy with online influence campaigns, U.S. officials said.

title: James Talarico, Seeking Black Votes in Texas Senate Rate, Wins Crucial Endorsement
summary: The Congressional Black Caucus’s political wing backed James Talarico, who defeated a Black opponent in the primary. He faces Ken Paxton, the Republican state attorney general, in November.

title: Republicans Are Now the ‘Elitist’ Party, Voters Say
summary: We spoke to independents who have soured on Trump.

title: A Central African Hotel Has Become a Nightmare Prison for U.S. Deportees
summary: Witnesses say men were hooded and beaten in Equatorial Guinea. The autocratic government there is a partner in President Trump’s deportation program.

title: Appeals Court Restricts Trump Administration Deportation Effort
summary: The ruling allows migrants to contest deportations to countries other than their place of origin. The case could head to the Supreme Court.

title: Two Centuries On, Smithsonian Connects Jefferson’s Hair to Hemings’s Children
summary: A new book describes how cutting-edge genomics techniques yielded “extraordinary proof” that Thomas Jefferson fathered children with Sally Hemings.

title: Holdout Juror in Lindsay Clancy Case Says He Didn’t Doubt Her Guilt
summary: The juror, Michael P. Desronvil, defended his decision not to join other jurors in voting for Ms. Clancy’s acquittal.

title: Steven Kolb, CFDA Head, Resigns After Confrontation With PETA Protesters
summary: Steven Kolb, the head of the Council of Fashion Designers of America for two decades, has stepped down after a physical altercation at a runway show.

title: Why Israel Fears This Searing New Documentary

title: The Kennedy Center Is Trump’s Most Grotesque Obsession
summary: Nothing has so thoroughly highlighted his indefatigable petulance.

title: Duncan Sheik, Who Traded Pop Stardom for Broadway, Dies at 56
summary: Weary of the heartthrob label after his 1996 hit “Barely Breathing,” he pivoted to musical theater and won two Tonys for composing “Spring Awakening.”
